Another one-shot @threejs Three.js test with @AnthropicAI Claude Fable 5.2 (high).

This time I asked it to build a complete futuristic Mars rover experience from scratch - procedurally modeled, with no external 3D assets.

The result ended up being far more complex than I expected:

~112k triangles
six-wheel articulated suspension
steerable corner wheels
sensor mast with cameras + lidar
5-axis robotic arm with drill
solar panels, radiators, antenna, RTG and internal battery compartment
autonomous 119 m route with three stops
terrain scanning, arm deployment and drilling at each stop
drill tip placement within ~1 cm of the target
independent wheel suspension following the terrain
tire tracks and dust
exploded view with 14 labeled assemblies
X-ray, night mode and multiple camera systems
7 cinematic camera shots
full mission HUD with speed, heading, pitch, roll, suspension travel, battery, signal, odometer and event log

Again: one prompt, one pass.

No follow-up prompts, no manual fixes, no cleanup.

What impressed me most is how much engineering logic, motion behavior and visual design it resolved on its own.

Fable 5.2 in high mode is seriously strong for this kind of creative coding.
items.why: 作者用 Fable 5.2 high 一次出片，在 Three.js 里从零程序化做出火星车，没有外部 3D 资产，并包含完整任务镜头和 HUD。
